answer.title: Auto-Create Invoice on Job Completion
answer.trigger: A technician marks a job as complete in the jobs system.
steps: Detect when a job status changes to complete in the jobs system
Extract job details, customer information, and line items
Draft a new invoice in the accounts system using the job details
Send the drafted invoice to Emma for review
answer.ai_help: Extracting line items and matching the job details to the correct customer in the accounts system.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice before it is finalized and sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: An incorrect invoice amount or wrong billing details could be sent to a customer if not checked.
